content.heading: When police may arrest without warrant
content.text: A police officer may, without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant, arrest a person who commits a cognizable offence in his presence, or against whom a reasonable complaint, credible information or reasonable suspicion exists of a cognizable offence, subject to the conditions enacted in this section. Where arrest is not required, the officer shall issue a notice of appearance. Read the official clauses including the notice-before-arrest rule that replaces CrPC 41A.
